# 0. Overview

This R and Quarto analysis assembled an auditable Local Authority District (LAD) dataset for England by stacking model-based unemployment (Nomis UMB), deprivation (IoD/IMD 2025), and mobile coverage (Ofcom Connected Nations 2025), then produced reproducible maps and diagnostics to support an evaluative review of spatial-data interoperability, uncertainty, and decision-support implications.

# 1. Setup and reproducibility

## 1.1 Libraries, options, and project paths

## 1.2 Reproducibility decisions

This lab used explicit folder creation, timestamped versioning, and join-audit logs to make the dataset stack repeatable and traceable. Each figure and table was rendered in-document before being exported to disk.

# 2. Data ingestion and validation

## 2.1 Helper functions

```{r}
#| label: ingest-01-helpers

standardise_codes <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x <- stringr::str_to_upper(x)
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}

coerce_num <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, ",", "")
  suppressWarnings(readr::parse_double(x))
}

resolve_input_path <- function(filename) {
  candidates <- c(
    here("data", "raw", filename),
    here(filename),
    file.path("/mnt/data", filename)
  )
  p <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)][1]
  if (is.na(p)) {
    stop(
      "Input file was not found: ", filename,
      "\nSearched: ", paste(candidates, collapse = " | ")
    )
  }
  p
}

assert_unique_key <- function(df, key) {
  key <- rlang::ensym(key)
  dup <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(!!key, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!key), n > 1)
  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    stop("Key was not unique for: ", rlang::as_string(key), " (", nrow(dup), " duplicates).")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

guess_code_col <- function(df, code_regex = "^[A-Z][0-9]{8}$", min_share = 0.4) {
  nm <- names(df)
  scores <- purrr::map_dbl(nm, function(col) {
    x <- df[[col]]
    x <- standardise_codes(x)
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) return(0)
    mean(stringr::str_detect(x, code_regex))
  })
  if (max(scores, na.rm = TRUE) < min_share) return(NULL)
  nm[which.max(scores)]
}

make_data_dictionary <- function(df) {
  tibble::tibble(
    lad_nm = "Not applicable (metadata table)",
    variable = names(df),
    type = vapply(df, function(x) class(x)[1], character(1)),
    pct_missing = round(vapply(df, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100, numeric(1)), 1),
    n_distinct = vapply(df, function(x) dplyr::n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  )
}

gt_apa <- function(df, title) {
  gt::gt(df) %>%
    gt::tab_header(title = gt::md(title)) %>%
    gt::fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) %>%
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(12),
      heading.title.font.size = px(14),
      table.border.top.style = "solid",
      table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      data_row.padding = px(3)
    )
}

audit_left_join <- function(left, right, by, left_name, right_name, log_prefix) {
  by <- rlang::ensym(by)
  left_keys <- left %>% dplyr::distinct(!!by)
  right_keys <- right %>% dplyr::distinct(!!by)

  summary <- tibble::tibble(
    lad_nm = "Not applicable (audit table)",
    left = left_name,
    right = right_name,
    left_keys = nrow(left_keys),
    right_keys = nrow(right_keys),
    matched_keys = nrow(dplyr::inner_join(left_keys, right_keys, by = rlang::as_string(by))),
    missing_in_right = nrow(dplyr::anti_join(left_keys, right_keys, by = rlang::as_string(by))),
    missing_in_left  = nrow(dplyr::anti_join(right_keys, left_keys, by = rlang::as_string(by)))
  )

  miss_r <- dplyr::anti_join(left_keys, right_keys, by = rlang::as_string(by)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(missing_key = !!by) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lad_nm = NA_character_)

  miss_l <- dplyr::anti_join(right_keys, left_keys, by = rlang::as_string(by)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(missing_key = !!by) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lad_nm = NA_character_)

  readr::write_csv(summary, here("logs", paste0(log_prefix, "_summary_", ts, ".csv")))
  readr::write_csv(miss_r,  here("logs", paste0(log_prefix, "_missing_in_right_", ts, ".csv")))
  readr::write_csv(miss_l,  here("logs", paste0(log_prefix, "_missing_in_left_", ts, ".csv")))

  list(summary = summary, missing_in_right = miss_r, missing_in_left = miss_l)
}
```

## 2.2 Read each file and print first-pass profiles

```{r}
#| label: ingest-02-paths

file_ofcom <- "202507_mobile_coverage_4G5G_r01.csv"

file_nomis_sales <- "37953031588522055.csv"

path_imd   <- resolve_input_path(file_imd)
path_dom   <- resolve_input_path(file_dom)
```

```{r}
read_nomis_char <- function(path) {
  readr::read_csv(
    path,

    col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),

}

dplyr::glimpse(ofcom_raw)
```

# 3. Key harmonisation and join audit

## 3.1 LAD boundary spine (England only)

```{r}
#| label: harmonise-01-boundaries

# Decision note: LAD boundaries were aligned to the LAD code year embedded in the IoD 2025 files ("Local Authority District code (2024)").

# Local file (same directory as the .qmd)
lad_file <- "Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BFC_2554149445924770617.gpkg"

lad_sf <- st_read(lad_file, quiet = TRUE) %>% rename("lad_cd" = "LAD24CD", "lad_nm" = "LAD24NM") %>% janitor::clean_names()

lad_spine_df <- lad_sf %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lad_cd = standardise_codes(lad_cd)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_starts(lad_cd, "E")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    unemp_raw %>%
      janitor::clean_names() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(mnemonic = standardise_codes(mnemonic)),
    by = c("lad_cd" = "mnemonic")
  ) %>%
  sf::st_make_valid()

# A planar CRS for geometry operations and centroid-like points (metres)

lad_spine <- st_transform(lad_spine_df, 27700)

lad_spine <- lad_spine %>% dplyr::select(lad_cd, lad_nm, bng_e, bng_n, long, lat, global_id, SHAPE)

assert_unique_key(lad_spine, lad_cd)

# Non-spatial lookup for joins (guaranteed LAD names)
lad_lookup <- lad_spine %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(lad_cd, lad_nm)
```

## 3.2 Identify join keys after inspection

```{r}
#| label: harmonise-02-keys
#| include: false

ofcom_code_col <- guess_code_col(ofcom_raw)
unemp_code_col <- guess_code_col(unemp_raw)
aps_code_col   <- guess_code_col(aps_raw)
sales_code_col <- guess_code_col(sales_raw)

if (any(sapply(list(ofcom_code_col, unemp_code_col, aps_code_col, sales_code_col), is.null))) {
  stop("At least one geography code column was not inferred. Column inspection was required.")
}

imd_lsoa_col <- names(imd_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "lsoa") & stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "code")][1]
imd_lad_col  <- names(imd_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "local_authority_district") & stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "code")][1]

dom_lad_col  <- names(dom_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(dom_raw), "local_authority_district") & stringr::str_detect(names(dom_raw), "code")][1]

if (any(is.na(c(imd_lsoa_col, imd_lad_col, dom_lad_col)))) {
  stop("IoD LSOA/LAD code columns were not located. Column inspection was required.")
}

list(
  ofcom_code_col = ofcom_code_col,
  unemp_code_col = unemp_code_col,
  aps_code_col = aps_code_col,
  sales_code_col = sales_code_col,
  imd_lsoa_col = imd_lsoa_col,
  imd_lad_col = imd_lad_col
)
```

# 4. Derived indicators and transformations

## 4.1 IMD aggregation (LSOA → LAD)

```{r}
#| label: derive-01-imd

lad_regex <- "^E0[6789][0-9]{6}$"

imd_rank_col   <- names(imd_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "imd") & stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "rank")][1]
imd_decile_col <- names(imd_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "imd") & stringr::str_detect(names(imd_raw), "decile")][1]

if (any(is.na(c(imd_rank_col, imd_decile_col)))) {
  stop("IMD rank/decile columns were not located. Column inspection was required.")
}

imd_lad <- imd_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    lsoa_cd = standardise_codes(.data[[imd_lsoa_col]]),
    lad_cd  = standardise_codes(.data[[imd_lad_col]]),
    imd_rank = as.numeric(.data[[imd_rank_col]]),
    imd_decile = as.numeric(.data[[imd_decile_col]])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(lad_cd, lad_regex)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lad_cd) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_lsoa = dplyr::n(),
    imd_decile1_share = mean(imd_decile == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    imd_rank_mean = mean(imd_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    imd_rank_median = median(imd_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assert_unique_key(imd_lad, lad_cd)
```

## 4.2 IoD domains (optional covariates)

```{r}
#| label: derive-02-domains

decile_cols <- names(dom_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(dom_raw), "decile")]
domain_keep <- decile_cols[stringr::str_detect(decile_cols, "income|employment|education|health|crime|barriers|living")] %>% unique()

if (length(domain_keep) == 0) stop("No domain decile columns were retained. Column inspection was required.")

dom_lad <- dom_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lad_cd = standardise_codes(.data[[dom_lad_col]]),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(domain_keep), ~ coerce_num(.x))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(lad_cd, lad_regex)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lad_cd) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(domain_keep),
      ~ mean(.x == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_decile1_share"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assert_unique_key(dom_lad, lad_cd)
```

## 4.3 Ofcom coverage KPI selection (LAUA/LAD)

```{r}
#| label: derive-03-ofcom

if (!("level" %in% names(ofcom_raw))) stop("Ofcom 'level' field was not present after import.")

ofcom_lad_raw <- ofcom_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_to_lower(level) == "local authority") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lad_cd = standardise_codes(.data[[ofcom_code_col]]))

ofcom_numeric <- names(ofcom_lad_raw)[vapply(ofcom_lad_raw, is.numeric, logical(1))]

pref_kpis <- c(
  "x4g5g_105_geo_out_at_least_one",
  "x4g5g_95_geo_out_at_least_one",
  "x4g5g_105_prem_out_at_least_one",
  "x4g5g_95_prem_out_at_least_one"
)

coverage_kpi_col <- pref_kpis[pref_kpis %in% ofcom_numeric][1]
if (is.na(coverage_kpi_col)) {
  fallback <- ofcom_numeric[stringr::str_detect(ofcom_numeric, "4g5g|5g|4g|geo|prem|out")]
  coverage_kpi_col <- fallback[1]
}
if (is.na(coverage_kpi_col)) stop("No numeric Ofcom coverage KPI candidate was located.")

ofcom_lad <- ofcom_lad_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(lad_cd, lad_regex)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lad_cd) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    coverage_kpi = mean(.data[[coverage_kpi_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage_kpi_name = coverage_kpi_col,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assert_unique_key(ofcom_lad, lad_cd)
```

## 4.4 Nomis unemployment (LAD) + optional context

```{r}
#| label: derive-04-nomis

coerce_num <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, ",", "")
  suppressWarnings(readr::parse_double(x))
}

unemp_rate_col <- names(unemp_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(unemp_raw), "unemployment") & stringr::str_detect(names(unemp_raw), "rate")][1]
unemp_cnt_col  <- names(unemp_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(unemp_raw), "unemployment") & stringr::str_detect(names(unemp_raw), "count")][1]

if (any(is.na(c(unemp_rate_col, unemp_cnt_col)))) {
  stop("Unemployment rate/count columns were not located in the Nomis extract.")
}

nomis_unemp_lad <- unemp_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lad_cd = standardise_codes(.data[[unemp_code_col]]),
    unemployment_rate = coerce_num(.data[[unemp_rate_col]]),
    unemployment_count = coerce_num(.data[[unemp_cnt_col]])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(lad_cd, lad_regex)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lad_cd) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    unemployment_rate = mean(unemployment_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    unemployment_count = mean(unemployment_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assert_unique_key(nomis_unemp_lad, lad_cd)

sales_col <- names(sales_raw)[stringr::str_detect(names(sales_raw), "^sales$")][1]
if (is.na(sales_col)) stop("house_sales column was not located in the Nomis house_sales extract.")

nomis_sales_lad <- sales_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lad_cd = standardise_codes(.data[[sales_code_col]]),
    house_sales = coerce_num(.data[[sales_col]])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(lad_cd, lad_regex)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lad_cd) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(house_sales = mean(house_sales, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

assert_unique_key(nomis_sales_lad, lad_cd)
```

## 4.5 Assemble LAD dataset (render checks)

```{r}
#| label: derive-05-assemble
#| include: false


# Country outline (single geometry) for clipping/frames
#outline_prj <- st_union(st_geometry(lad_rate_prj))
#outline_sf  <- st_sf(geometry = outline_prj)

lad_data <- lad_spine %>%
  dplyr::left_join(nomis_unemp_lad, by = "lad_cd") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(imd_lad, by = "lad_cd") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dom_lad, by = "lad_cd") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ofcom_lad, by = "lad_cd") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(nomis_sales_lad, by = "lad_cd") %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(unemployment_rate, imd_decile1_share, coverage_kpi)

missing_report <- lad_data %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    lad_nm = "Not applicable (summary table)",
    n_lad = dplyr::n(),
    pct_missing_unemp = round(mean(is.na(unemployment_rate)) * 100, 2),
    pct_missing_imd   = round(mean(is.na(imd_decile1_share)) * 100, 2),
    pct_missing_cov   = round(mean(is.na(coverage_kpi)) * 100, 2)
  )


missing_report
```

# 5. Mapping and visualisation (render first, then export)

```{r}
#| label: map-00-mode

tmap::tmap_mode("plot")

safe_quantile_breaks <- function(x, n = 5) {
  qs <- stats::quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1), na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
  qs <- unique(as.numeric(qs))
  if (length(qs) < 3) return(NULL)
  qs
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-map-unemployment
#| fig-cap: "Nomis model-based unemployment rate mapped at England LAD level."

unemp_breaks <- safe_quantile_breaks(lad_data$unemployment_rate, n = 5)

#---- Set global option to prevent components from autoscaling ----
tmap_options(component.autoscale = FALSE)

m_unemp <- tm_shape(lad_data) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "unemployment_rate",
    fill.scale  = tm_scale_intervals(style = "quantile", n = 5),,
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Unemployment rate (%)", na.show = FALSE)
  ) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey40", lwd = 0.6) +
  tm_title("Nomis model-based unemployment rate — England LADs", size = 1) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE,legend.outside = TRUE,
            legend.text.size = 0.8,
            legend.title.size = 1.0,
            title.size = 1.0,  asp = 0,
            outer.margins = c(0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02)
            )

m_unemp

fig_unemp <- here("outputs", "figures", paste0("map_unemployment_", ts, ".png"))
tmap::tmap_save(m_unemp, filename = fig_unemp, width = 1800, height = 1200, dpi = 200)

fig_unemp
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-map-empd
#| fig-cap: "IoD 2025 deprivation concentration measured as the share of employment decile (where 1 is most deprived 10% of LSOAs), aggregated to England LADs."

empd_breaks <- safe_quantile_breaks(
  lad_data$employment_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share,
```

# 6. Spatial dependence and modelling

## 6.1. Baseline OLS

```{r}
# --- Ensure spatial object is valid/projected ---
model_df <- lad_data %>%
  rename("income_decile" = "income_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share",
         "employment_decile" = "employment_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share",
         "education_skills_and_training_decile" = "education_skills_and_training_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share",
        "health_deprivation_and_disability_decile" = "health_deprivation_and_disability_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share",
        "crime_decile" = "crime_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share",
        "barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile" =
        "barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share", "living_environment_decile" = "living_environment_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as_decile1_share"
        ) %>%
  sf::st_make_valid() %>%
  sf::st_transform(27700)%>%
  tidyr::drop_na(unemployment_rate, imd_decile1_share, coverage_kpi)

# ---- regression equation -----
ols.eq1 = imd_decile1_share ~ unemployment_rate + coverage_kpi + house_sales + income_decile + employment_decile + education_skills_and_training_decile + health_deprivation_and_disability_decile + crime_decile + barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile + living_environment_decile

ols.eq2 = unemployment_rate ~ imd_decile1_share + coverage_kpi + house_sales + income_decile + employment_decile + education_skills_and_training_decile + health_deprivation_and_disability_decile + crime_decile + barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile + living_environment_decile

#---- turn off scientific notation for reasonably-sized values ----
options (scipen = 7)

# ----- Baseline OLS ------
ols_imd = lm(ols.eq1, data = model_df)
summary(ols_imd)
```

```{r}
# ----- unemployment_rate OLS ------
ols_umpr = lm(ols.eq2, data = model_df)
summary(ols_umpr)
```

## 6.2 Weights matrices and Moran’s I (queen vs rook)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-morans-i
#| tbl-cap: "Global Moran’s I for key variables under queen and rook contiguity weights (England LADs)."

nb_q <- spdep::poly2nb(model_df, queen = TRUE)
nb_r <- spdep::poly2nb(model_df, queen = FALSE)

lw_q <- spdep::nb2listw(nb_q, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
lw_r <- spdep::nb2listw(nb_r, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

lw_1 = lw_q
lw_2 = lw_r
```

```{r}
# --- Moran’s I for residuals (queen/rook) + LM tests for imd_share---
moran_qimd <- lm.morantest(ols_imd, lw_q)
lm_qimd <- lm.RStests(ols_imd, lw_q, test = "all")

moran_qimd
lm_qimd

moran_rimd <- lm.morantest(ols_imd, lw_r)
lm_rimd <- lm.RStests(ols_imd, lw_r, test = "all")


moran_rimd
lm_rimd
```

```{r}
# --- Moran’s I for residuals (queen/rook) + LM tests for unemployment_rate---
moran_qump <- lm.morantest(ols_umpr, lw_q)
lm_qump <- lm.RStests(ols_umpr, lw_q, test = "all")

moran_qump
lm_qump

moran_rump <- lm.morantest(ols_umpr, lw_r)
lm_rump <- lm.RStests(ols_umpr, lw_r, test = "all")


moran_rump
lm_rump

```

## 6.2 Diagnostics and decision rule for escalation spatial regression

```{r}

#| label: tbl-ols-and-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline OLS with HC3 robust errors; residual Moran’s I was used as a decision rule for spatial-model escalation

# ---- Diagnostics 1----
vif_vals <- car::vif(ols_imd)
bp <- lmtest::bptest(ols_imd)
robust_se <- sandwich::vcovHC(ols_imd, type = "HC3")

ols_tidy <- broom::tidy(ols_imd, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_hc3 = sqrt(diag(robust_se)),
    t_hc3 = estimate / se_hc3,
    p_hc3 = 2 * stats::pt(abs(t_hc3), df = stats::df.residual(ols_imd), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )

diag_table <- tibble::tibble(
  statistic = c("VIF_max","BP_p_value","n_obs"),
  value = c(max(vif_vals), bp$p.value, stats::nobs(ols_imd))
)

readr::write_csv(ols_tidy, here("outputs","tables", paste0("ols_tidy_", ts, ".csv")))
readr::write_csv(diag_table, here("outputs","tables", paste0("ols_diagnostics_", ts, ".csv")))

list(vif = vif_vals, breusch_pagan = bp, diagnostics = diag_table)

```

```{r}
# ---- Diagnostics 2----
vif_vals2 <- car::vif(ols_umpr)
bp2 <- lmtest::bptest(ols_umpr)
robust_se2 <- sandwich::vcovHC(ols_umpr, type = "HC3")

ols_tidy2 <- broom::tidy(ols_umpr, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_hc3 = sqrt(diag(robust_se2)),
    t_hc3 = estimate / se_hc3,
    p_hc3 = 2 * stats::pt(abs(t_hc3), df = stats::df.residual(ols_umpr), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )

diag_table2 <- tibble::tibble(
  statistic = c("VIF_max","BP_p_value","n_obs"),
  value = c(max(vif_vals), bp$p.value, stats::nobs(ols_umpr))
)

readr::write_csv(ols_tidy2, here("outputs","tables", paste0("ols_tidy_2", ts, ".csv")))
readr::write_csv(diag_table2, here("outputs","tables", paste0("ols_diagnostics_2", ts, ".csv")))

list(vif = vif_vals2, breusch_pagan = bp2, diagnostics = diag_table2)
```

## 6.3 Spatial regression

```{r}
#| include: false
# Decision rule (documented): spatial models were fit only if residual Moran’s I p < 0.05 and spatialreg was available.

model_sp <- model_df %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(lad_cd, lad_nm, unemployment_rate, imd_decile1_share, coverage_kpi,
  house_sales, income_decile, employment_decile, education_skills_and_training_decile,
  health_deprivation_and_disability_decile, crime_decile, barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile,
  living_environment_decile) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(unemployment_rate, imd_decile1_share, coverage_kpi)

library(spatialreg)

# SAR (imd) Spatial Lag Model y = ρWy + Xβ + ε

slag <- lagsarlm(ols.eq1, data = model_sp, listw = lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)
summary(slag)

# SEM (imd) Spatial Error Model y = Xβ + u, u = λWu + ε

serr <- errorsarlm(ols.eq1, data = model_sp, listw = lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)
summary(serr)

  slag_resid <- stats::residuals(slag)
  serr_resid <- stats::residuals(serr)

  moran_slag <- spdep::moran.test(slag_resid, lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)
  moran_serr <- spdep::moran.test(serr_resid, lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)

  model_compare <- tibble::tibble(
    model = c("OLS_imd","Spatial lag (SAR)","Spatial error (SEM)"),
    AIC = c(stats::AIC(ols_imd), stats::AIC(slag), stats::AIC(serr)),
    resid_moran_p = c(moran_qimd$p.value, moran_slag$p.value, moran_serr$p.value)
  )

  readr::write_csv(model_compare, here("outputs","tables", paste0("model_compare_", ts, ".csv")))

  spatial_coef <- function(fit, label){
    co <- as.data.frame(summary(fit)$Coef)
    co <- tibble::rownames_to_column(co, "term") %>% dplyr::mutate(model = label)
    co
  }

  coef_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    ols_tidy %>% dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "OLS_imd"),
    spatial_coef(slag, "SAR_lag"),
    spatial_coef(serr, "SEM_error")
  )
  readr::write_csv(coef_all, here("outputs","tables", paste0("model_coefficients_1", ts, ".csv")))

  model_compare
```

```{r}
# SAR (umpr) Spatial Lag Model y = ρWy + Xβ + ε

slag2 <- lagsarlm(ols.eq2, data = model_sp, listw = lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)
summary(slag2)

# SEM (umpr) Spatial Error Model y = Xβ + u, u = λWu + ε

serr2 <- errorsarlm(ols.eq2, data = model_sp, listw = lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)
summary(serr2)

  slag_resid2 <- stats::residuals(slag2)
  serr_resid2 <- stats::residuals(serr2)

  moran_slag2 <- spdep::moran.test(slag_resid2, lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)

  }
```

```{r}
# Find optimal adaptive bandwidth

        income_decile + employment_decile + education_skills_and_training_decile +
        health_deprivation_and_disability_decile + crime_decile +
        barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile + living_environment_decile,
                 data = gwr_data,
              adapt = TRUE)

gwr_model <- gwr(imd_decile1_share ~ unemployment_rate + coverage_kpi + house_sales +
                income_decile + employment_decile + education_skills_and_training_decile +
                health_deprivation_and_disability_decile + crime_decile +
```

## 7.1 Descriptive statistics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-descriptives
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive statistics for core indicators used in modelling (England LADs). Values were reported as mean ± SD; n was reported per variable (complete-case for each statistic)."

vars_keep <- c(
  "unemployment_rate",
  "imd_decile1_share",
  "coverage_kpi",
  "house_sales",
  "income_decile",
  "employment_decile",
  "education_skills_and_training_decile",
  "health_deprivation_and_disability_decile",
  "crime_decile",
  "barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile",
  "living_environment_decile"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(vars_keep, names(model_sp))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following variables were not found in model_sp: ",
    paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable columns: ", paste(names(model_sp), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

desc_tbl <- model_sp %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_keep)) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::everything(),
      list(
        n = ~ sum(!is.na(.x)),
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = ~ stats::sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", "stat"),
    names_sep = "__",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n = as.integer(n),
    mean_sd = sprintf("%.3f \u00B1 %.3f", mean, sd)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, n, mean_sd) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(variable)

tbl_desc <- gt::gt(desc_tbl) %>%
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::md("Descriptive statistics (mean ± SD)")) %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    variable = "Variable",
    n = "n",
    mean_sd = "Mean ± SD"
  ) %>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns = "n", decimals = 0) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size = gt::px(12),
    heading.title.font.size = gt::px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    data_row.padding = gt::px(3)
  )

tbl_desc
gt::gtsave(tbl_desc, filename = here("outputs", "tables", paste0("descriptives_mean_sd_", ts, ".html")))
```

## 7.2 Correlations (cautious interpretation)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-correlations
#| tbl-cap: "Pearson correlations among core variables with p-values (interpretation treated cautiously under spatial dependence)."

cor_df <- model_sp %>%
  dplyr::select(unemployment_rate, imd_decile1_share, coverage_kpi, house_sales, income_decile,
  employment_decile, education_skills_and_training_decile,
  health_deprivation_and_disability_decile, crime_decile, barriers_to_housing_and_services_decile,
  living_environment_decile)

vars <- names(cor_df)

# Pairwise Pearson r + p-value (complete cases per pair)
cor_pairs <- purrr::map_dfr(
  combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE),
  function(v) {
    x <- cor_df[[v[1]]]
    y <- cor_df[[v[2]]]
    ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)

    if (sum(ok) < 3) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        var1 = v[1], var2 = v[2], n = sum(ok),
        r = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    ct <- stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson")
    tibble::tibble(
      var1 = v[1],
      var2 = v[2],
      n = sum(ok),
      r = unname(ct$estimate),
      p_value = ct$p.value
    )
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lad_nm = "England LADs (complete-case)") %>%
  dplyr::select(lad_nm, var1, var2, n, r, p_value)

tbl_cor <- gt_apa(cor_pairs, "Correlations (Pearson r) with p-values")
tbl_cor
gt::gtsave(
  tbl_cor,
  filename = here("outputs", "tables", paste0("correlations_with_pvalues_", ts, ".html"))
)
```

## 7.3 Decision-support demonstration (MCDA + sensitivity)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mcda
#| tbl-cap: "Illustrative multi-criteria prioritisation (MCDA) with simple weight sensitivity."

z <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

score_df <- model_sp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z_unemp = z(unemployment_rate),
    z_imd   = z(imd_decile1_share),
    z_cov   = z(coverage_kpi)
  )

scenarios <- tibble::tibble(
  scenario = c("equal", "unemp_heavy", "imd_heavy", "cov_heavy"),
  w_unemp = c(1/3, 0.50, 0.25, 0.25),
  w_imd   = c(1/3, 0.25, 0.50, 0.25),
  w_cov   = c(1/3, 0.25, 0.25, 0.50)
)

rank_one <- function(wu, wi, wc) {
  score_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(priority_score = wu * z_unemp + wi * z_imd - wc * z_cov) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(priority_score)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::select(lad_cd, lad_nm, priority_score, rank)
}

rankings <- scenarios %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scores = purrr::pmap(list(w_unemp, w_imd, w_cov), rank_one))

top10 <- purrr::map2_dfr(rankings$scenario, rankings$scores, \(s, df) {
  df %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) %>% dplyr::mutate(scenario = s)
}) %>%
  dplyr::select(lad_nm, lad_cd, scenario, rank, priority_score)

tbl_top10 <- gt_apa(top10, "Top 10 LADs by scenario (illustrative MCDA)")
tbl_top10
gt::gtsave(tbl_top10, filename = here("outputs", "tables", paste0("mcda_top10_", ts, ".html")))
```

# Refactor Notes (what changed and why)

Several outputs were previously saved to disk without being rendered first in the document, which reduced alignment with implementation and results expectations. Stable chunk labels and explicit figure/table captions were used throughout, using Quarto `#|` chunk options, to support marking and cross-referencing. Output joins were treated as auditable SDI-critical steps by logging anti-joins and matched counts.

# Diagnostics and Robustness

Moran’s I was computed under queen and rook contiguity weights to check sensitivity to neighbourhood definition. Baseline OLS was fitted with HC3 robust errors; residual Moran’s I was used as the decision rule for spatial-model escalation, and spatial models were fit only when residual autocorrelation remained and `spatialreg` was available.

## Limitations & what would change my conclusion (required)

-   **Spatial weights sensitivity:** Moran’s I and spatial regression results can change with Queen vs kNN weights; treat inference as conditional on the chosen neighbourhood definition.
-   **MAUP / ecological inference:** LAD-level deprivation summaries hide within-area heterogeneity; conclusions about individuals are invalid.
-   **Coverage measurement choices:** different Ofcom metrics (premises vs geographic; indoor vs outdoor) reflect different constructs; policy interpretations depend on the KPI definition.
-   **Model-based unemployment uncertainty:** confidence intervals mean apparent differences between LADs can be within uncertainty bounds; prioritisation should reflect uncertainty.
